headline: EPS ticks up sequentially
summary_short: Suzhou TFC Optical Communication reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of CN¥0.47, up 3.9% q/q from CN¥0.45 in Q1 FY2026.
summary_long: EPS of CN¥0.47 rose 3.9% sequentially from CN¥0.45 in Q1 FY2026. No year-over-year comparison, revenue, margin, or cash-position figures are available on the shard for this period.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. Two WebSearch queries and one WebFetch (a second WebFetch to marketscreener.com returned HTTP 403) failed to surface a fetchable non-aggregator primary within budget — this is a Shenzhen ChiNext (300394.SZ) A-share filer with no edgarCik, so no EDGAR fallback exists; the interim report itself (filed ~Aug 19 2026 per a TradingView/Quartr summary) was not directly reachable. Aggregator wire recaps (MarketScreener, TradingView/Quartr) reported H1 2026 CUMULATIVE (six-month, not quarter-only) figures: revenue CN¥2.83bn (+15.15% y/y), net profit CN¥1.20bn (+33.92% y/y), optical-interconnect gross margin 60.67% (vs 50.54% y/y), operating cash flow CN¥1.00bn (+64.57% y/y), R&D spend CN¥194.93m (+55.32% y/y), and basic EPS CN¥1.1057 (+33.55% y/y). These are cumulative H1 figures on a different basis than the shard's discrete-quarter EPS KPI above, so they were not folded into the KPI ledger; they were checked against the Step 3b extended-metrics registry (technology sectorTag: arr, wafer_starts, capex_intensity) but none of the disclosed figures map to those specific metrics at confidence ≥0.7, so extendedMetrics is empty for this pass.
